verdict.rationale: n8n has a first-party docs page titled "n8n API" in its Connect section, so a public API is documented. But the pack shows only the page title, not what the API does, how it authenticates, or which workflow, execution or credential operations it exposes. The OpenAPI probe returning 404 on docs paths shows only that no spec sits at those URLs; it does not show the API is missing. missing for 10: API scope and endpoint details, authentication model, a published machine-readable spec (OpenAPI/Swagger), hands-on or independent confirmation of driving n8n programmatically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
